GeneSymbol.description: Source spelling of a gene symbol, with ASCII case-insensitive identity.

GwasOrder.description: Native source order, echoed without a configurable sort command.

GwasStudyId.description: Exact Catalog study accession; case and leading zeros survive.

GwasTraitId.description: Native ontology identifier; namespaces are preserved without an EFO restriction.

RsId.description: A dbSNP site identifier, never an allele join key.

Text.description: Nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

description: Source associations in default p-value-ascending order. Reports no personal risk, causal variant or gene, or clinical interpretation of a statistic.

extended_geneset.description: Source extended gene set; requires gene.

gene.description: Exact native mapped gene; legacy positional query aliases this field.

p_value.description: Inclusive positive probability in scientific notation. Requires the default p-value-ascending order; no sort option is available. The qualifying total stays unknown until the ordered walk reaches its end.

pool.description: Retained threshold walk identity; requires a threshold.

query.description: Exact native mapped gene; legacy positional query aliases this field.

trait.description: Literal native efo_trait label; never searches reported_trait prose.

title: GwasSearchCommand
